iTag & iTag Tracker for Android & iOS
The iTag is a revolutionary smart tracking device designed to help you keep track of your valuables effortlessly.
Whether you’re looking to locate your keys, wallet, or even your pet, the iTag ensures you never lose sight of what matters most.
Compatible with iTag Android devices, this compact and lightweight tracker seamlessly integrates with your smartphone, providing real-time location updates with just a tap.
With the iTag tracker, you can enjoy peace of mind knowing your belongings are always within reach.
The iTag Android app allows you to set up custom alerts, track multiple iTags simultaneously, and even share your iTags with family or friends.
The intuitive interface makes it easy to manage your iTags, ensuring a hassle-free experience.
